question: Can you provide the highest and lowest profits for Italian customers segmented into ten evenly divided tiers based on their December 2021 sales profits?
sql:
-- Final result: highest and lowest profits per tier
WITH italian_customers AS (
  SELECT c.cust_id 
  FROM customers c 
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id 
  WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
),
customer_profits AS (
  SELECT p.cust_id, SUM(p.amount_sold - p.TOTAL_COST) AS total_profit
  FROM profits p
  JOIN italian_customers ic ON p.cust_id = ic.cust_id
  WHERE p.time_id >= '2021-12-01' AND p.time_id < '2022-01-01'
  GROUP BY p.cust_id
),
tiered AS (
  SELECT total_profit, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit) AS tier
  FROM customer_profits
)
SELECT 
  'Tier ' || tier AS tier_label,
  ROUND(MAX(total_profit), 2) AS highest_profit,
  ROUND(MIN(total_profit), 2) AS lowest_profit
FROM tiered
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY tier
